### South African Reserve Bank

**Role:** SAMOS RTGS operator / payment regulator

**Reporting coverage:** DomesticRTGS ISO 20022 migration; CAMT052/053 profile not established

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 RTGS; exact reporting identifiers not verified

- [ISO 20022 postgolive announcement](https://www.resbank.co.za/en/home/publications/publication-detail-pages/media-releases/2022/ISO-20022-Post-go-live-press-release) — availability; public-page
